test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following taxes/duties is NOT covered under GST?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Stamp duty**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Stamp duty **is a tax that is levied on single property purchases or documents.
 
• A physical revenue stamp had to be attached to or impressed upon the document to show that stamp duty had been paid before the document was legally effective

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In India, Entertainment Tax is **a tax imposed by the government on feature films getting a wide release in the country and are reduced from gross collections, major commercial shows and big private festivals**.
 
• The amount after deducting entertainment tax is known as net.Central excise duty is **an indirect tax, i.e. each person, rich or poor, is liable to pay tax indirectly on purchase of goods which have already been charged to duty**.
 
• Value-added tax (VAT) is **a consumption tax on goods and services that is levied at each stage of the supply chain where value is added, from initial production to the point of sale**.
